recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Chocolate Chip Buns (No Yeast)

items.i: thick cottage cheese (or thick Greek yogurt)
all-purpose flour, plus more as needed
melted butter or oil spray, for brushing

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Blend the cottage cheese until completely smooth (immersion blender, small food processor or single-serve blender).
Whisk the blended cottage cheese, egg and vanilla together.
In another bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix until just combined. Add a little more flour if needed for a firm, scoopable dough, then gently fold in the chocolate chips.
Dollop into 6 mounds on the baking sheet (rustic is fine) and brush with melted butter or spray with oil.
Bake 20–24 minutes until golden. Let cool slightly before serving.
recipes.notes: Recipe and nutrition are the creator's, per bun. Use a thick cottage cheese: if the dough is runny, the buns spread flat, so add flour until it holds a mound. Add 1–2 tbsp sugar to the dry ingredients for a sweeter bun. Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 2 months frozen; warm in the oven.
